headline: Costa Rica Dollar Depreciation Depresses Colón Pension Fund Values
summary: A 9% decline in the US dollar has cut the colón value of Costa Rican pension funds' foreign currency assets, prompting regulator Supen to issue alerts regarding pension returns.
why: Currency swings in Latin American pension systems create marked fluctuations in worker retirement portfolios and cross-border allocation strategy.

impacts.name: Costa Rican Colón
impacts.why: A 9% appreciation against the dollar erodes the colón conversion value of foreign pension assets.
